name: Centro de Arte Fundación Ortiz-Gurdián
known: Founders: the Ortiz Gurdián family bought and restored the León houses (DANTEmag).

name: Musée National Boubou Hama
known: Its first conservator, Pablo Toucet, designed it as part of the Culture Valley of Niamey, an idea proposed by Boubou Hama, after whom the museum is named (Wikipedia).
The director in 2025 was Abdouramane Gabidan (Internazionale, 24 October 2025, from Shola Lawal and Hannane Ferdjani of Al Jazeera).

name: Museum of West African Art (MOWAA)
known: Phillip Ihenacho is executive director and chair.
The first building is about 4,000 square metres of rammed earth, with an auditorium, conservation lab, library, exhibition space and amphitheatre (The Art Newspaper).

A committee chaired by Adams Oshiomhole, set up by Governor Okpebholo in November 2025, reported in August 2026 that the Obaseki administration spent N3.8 billion, and listed donations of €4 million from Germany and $1.5 million from Leventis (ThisDay, 22 August 2026);

name: CCA Lagos (Centre for Contemporary Art)
known: Founded in December 2007 by curator Bisi Silva (1962 to 2019), who directed it until her death.
The centre's website lists Ade Hassan, MBE as Executive Director.
It closed for renovation and reopened on 12 February 2025 with the exhibition "Archives and Memories", curated by Favour Ritaro and run until 31 May 2025.
Founded in 2007 by curator Bisi Silva for visual art research and photography.

name: G.A.S. Foundation (Guest Artists Space)
known: The page names Oyindamola Lami Adeyemi as Executive Chairperson of Still Earth Holdings.
Board: Yinka Shonibare (chair), Bimpe Nkontchou, Tokini Peterside-Schwebig, Adeniyi Adenubi, Temitayo Ogunbiyi and Ugoma Ebilah.

name: Lagos Biennial
known: "Created and founded by artists in 2017".
Folakunle Oshun is its founder and artistic director (lagos-biennial.org;

The fourth edition, "REFUGE", ran from 3 to 10 February 2024 at Tafawa Balewa Square on Lagos Island, with Kathryn Weir and Folakunle Oshun as artistic directors (The Lagos Review, Toni Kan, 22 September 2023).
The fifth edition, "The Museum of Things Unseen", was announced for October 2026, curated by Sam Hopkins, Chinyere Obieze and Furen Dai (The Lagos Review, Toni Kan, 10 November 2025).

name: National Museum, Lagos
known: Daily Trust reported that the project began by digitising about 200 artefacts, and that later phases will cover expansion, conservation and visitor facilities.

Daily Trust reports that Musawa stressed public-private partnerships for sustaining cultural infrastructure and that the Commission's Director General, Olugbile Holloway, said the museum had not had an extensive renovation for two decades.

name: Yemisi Shyllon Museum of Art
known: Castellote became the museum's first director in December 2018 (The Art Newspaper, Wikipedia).
Gbenga Oyebode co-founded the law firm Aluko & Oyebode in 1993 and is chairman of Okomu Oil Palm Company Plc, in which he holds 4.37 percent (Billionaires.Africa, 18 October 2025).
Its 2026 free-admission funder chairs a palm-oil firm in a land dispute.

name: North Hamgyong Provincial Revolutionary History Museum
International Friendship Exhibition
known: Reuters named a luxury car from the late leader of the Hyundai Group, a clock from CNN's founder and a living-room set from a South Korean furniture maker (2006).
